high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the soft, warm hues of pink and orange in the sky. The sky is filled with scattered clouds that are tinged with these warm colors, creating a tranquil and picturesque atmosphere. The ocean dominates the lower portion of the image, with gentle waves rolling towards the shore. The water has a dark, almost brownish tone, which contrasts with the lighter colors of the sky. There are no visible people or objects in the water, suggesting a peaceful and undisturbed natural setting.
